scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
May the endless glory be with the Kingdom of Rune-Midgarts and its seven royal families!
Welcome to Gloria, the fortress in Siege Battle TE. We provide services in cooperation with Kafra and the major royal families of the kingdom.
Gloria?
About Siege Battle TE
About requirements for participation
Forget it.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
It has been named in honor of the seven royal families and the kingdom.
The whole city closely resembles Valkyrie Realm, and here resides the aspirations of the royal family for everyone.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
In Kafragarten of Aldebaran, managed by Gloria and Kafra Service, we have special rules that are slightly different from the existing ones.
We call it Siege Battle TE.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text: You should not have troubles understanding the new rules since it is simply about setting a limit on qualifications for participation.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
It is a new stage prepared by the royal family in order to let more people participate in siege battles.
Different rules are applied, and sufficient supports are provided since its atmosphere is similar to that of a gymnasium.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text: ^4d4dffTertiary job class and users with expanded levels are not allowed in Gloria and Kafragarten regions, where Siege Battle TE rules are applied.^000000

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
Also, we lend a variety of battlegears that you use only in corresponding regions for free.
This may be the biggest difference.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
^4d4dffNovice, primary, and secondary job classes are allowed to participate as well as extra job class.^000000
Of course, primary and secondary job classes are included as well.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
In other words, tertiary job class and jobs with expanded levels such as Kagerou and Oboro are not allowed.
Also, their buff effects get eliminated here.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text: Other than that, it is not much different from the existing siege battles.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text: May the glory of the royal family and Odin's protection be with you!

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
This warp gate here will let you go into Gloria region.
Please keep in mind that you are supposed to travel through warps here.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
You are now at the fortress in Gloria.
If you wish to return to Valkyrie Realm, you can travel through warp.

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
Welcome to Gloria.
Job classes that are allowed to participate in siege battles at the fortresses in Kafragarten and Gloria regions are limited to ^4d4dffprimary and secondary job classes as well as those without expanded levels.^000000

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
In Kafragarten and Gloria regions, you get separate missions.
Some of them are not related to Emperiums, so challenge yourself!

scripts.speaker: Guide Soldier
scripts.text:
The royal family and Kafra Service have prepared a variety of retal items for you.
Although the rental period is relatively short, it's all free. So, don't miss the chance!

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text:
Welcome to Kafra Service~ We always provide the best to our customers.
Finally, Kafra Service has established its own fortress!
What is Kafragarten?
What is Siege Battle TE?
Qualifications for participation
Forget it.

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text:
This is a fortress provided by Kafra Service in cooperation with the royal family of Rune-Midgarts.
It means 'Kafra's garden.'

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text:
Although it looks very similar to Luina
It should be fine since it's servicing different users.
It's like a training stage, so to speak.

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text:
Kafragarten is built in the region of Luina, and in Valkyrie Realm, the royal family's Gloria is founded.
Kafra Service hopes that you would gain valuable experience in this new fortress.

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text: Siege Battle TE is ^4d4dffsiege battles designed for primary and secondary job classes only, ruling out tertiary job class.^000000

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text: It's been newly established in an effort to allow more users to gain experience through siege battles.

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text: Moreover, for your convenience, we lend a variety of items that you can use only inside the corresponding fortress. So, take advantage of this opportunity.

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text:
As they say, 'action speaks louder than words.'
Now, go and see for yourself~

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text: Primary, secondary, and extra job classes without expanded levels as well as primary and secondary job classes are allowed to participate only.

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text: In other words, tertiary job class and jobs with expanded levels such as Kagerou and Oboro are not allowed.

scripts.speaker: Sorin
scripts.text: Kafra Service will do its utmost to bring joy to your life through Kafragarten.

scripts.speaker: Defolty
scripts.text: Kafragarten is like a mirrored image of Luina, so its structure is exactly the same as that of Luina.

scripts.speaker: Defolty
scripts.text:
You can travel by these warps here.
You can travel to Kafragarten using warp.

scripts.speaker: W
scripts.text:
You can travel to Luina using this warp here.
Make good use of it

scripts.speaker: W
scripts.text:
Who took the castle that was named after me, W?
Hehe doesn't it mean that I'm superior to Tailing?

scripts.speaker: Tailing
scripts.text:
This is the region of Kafragarten.
In siege battles in the regions of Kafragarten and Gloria, only primary and secondary job classes as well as users without expanded levels are allowed to participate.

scripts.speaker: Tailing
scripts.text:
... .
In Kafragarten and Gloria regions, you get separate missions.
So you should pay close attention.

scripts.speaker: Tailing
scripts.text: Also, we have prepared a variety of battlegears, which are available anytime upon your request.

scripts.speaker: Tailing
scripts.text: But obviously, they're only valid in the regions of Kafragarten and Gloria.

scripts.speaker: Tailing
scripts.text:
... ..
Ah if you think I'm mad because my name is missing from Kafragarten and if my way of speaking is a little stiff because of that

scripts.speaker: Tailing
scripts.text:
Oh my.
Is that really true?
No way. W is no better than me..hahaha.
